title: Risk-Calibrated Bayesian Streaming Intrusion Detection with SRE-Aligned Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2510.09619v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: [Corrected v2: an audit found that the score, threshold, and latency descriptions below are not what the shared codebase implements, and that the evaluation streams are assembled constructions. tldr: 本文提出将贝叶斯在线变点检测（BOCPD）与SRE错误预算对齐的决策阈值相结合，通过在假阳性和假阴性预算下优化期望运营成本，实现能适应分布漂移的风险校准流式入侵检测方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a risk-calibrated streaming intrusion detection approach that couples Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection (BOCPD) with SRE error-budget-aligned decision thresholds, optimizing expected operational cost under false-positive and false-negative budgets to adapt to distribution shift.
